From b648ce2a28ba83c4fa67c61fcc5983e15e9d4afb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Ville=20Syrj=C3=A4l=C3=A4?= <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2024 16:51:47 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/mst: Reject FEC+MST on ICL
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

ICL supposedly doesn't support FEC on MST. Reject it.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: d51f25eb479a ("drm/i915: Add DSC support to MST path")
Reviewed-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240402135148.23011-7-ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
index 819f3234de03..a11bc4fd3d65 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
@@ -1418,7 +1418,8 @@ static bool intel_dp_source_supports_fec(struct intel_dp *intel_dp,
 	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) >= 12)
 		return true;
 
-	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A)
+	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A &&
+	    !intel_crtc_has_type(pipe_config, INTEL_OUTPUT_DP_MST))
 		return true;
 
 	return false;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c`**
   - A condition was added to the function `intel_dp_source_supports_fec`. 
   - The new condition checks if the display version is 11, the encoder's port is not PORT_A, and also verifies that the current configuration does not involve a DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport (MST) output. 
   - This change effectively rejects the use of Forward Error Correction (FEC) when MST is in use on devices with display version 11.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `intel_dp.c` is directly related to the bug fix for the Intel Comet Lake (ICL) platform, which does not support FEC when using MST. 
- The added condition ensures that the system correctly identifies and rejects FEC in scenarios where MST is being utilized, thereby preventing potential compatibility issues. 
- This change is a response to a previous commit that introduced Display Stream Compression (DSC) support for MST, indicating that the current patch is addressing a limitation in that implementation.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915/mst: Reject FEC+MST on ICL
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

ICL supposedly doesn't support FEC on MST. Reject it.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: d51f25eb479a ("drm/i915: Add DSC support to MST path")
Reviewed-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240402135148.23011-7-ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the incorrect handling of Forward Error Correction (FEC) support in conjunction with Multi-Stream Transport (MST) on Intel Comet Lake (ICL) devices. The existing logic allowed FEC to be enabled even when MST was in use, which is not supported on ICL, leading to potential display issues or failures.

Here is the patch:
 
 static bool intel_dp_source_supports_fec(struct intel_dp *intel_dp,
 					 const struct intel_crtc_state *pipe_config)
 {
 	struct intel_encoder *encoder = &dp_to_dig_port(intel_dp)->base;
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = dp_to_i915(intel_dp);
 
 	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) >= 12)
 		return true;
 
-	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A)
+	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A &&
+	    !intel_crtc_has_type(pipe_config, INTEL_OUTPUT_DP_MST))
 		return true;
 
 	return false;
 }
